request: Analyze GSE320360 for PMID 42812173 (Acute aerobic exercise is associated with a biphasic, temporally ordered shift in serum extracellular vesicle microRNA expression in major depressive disorder.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: small RNA-seq (miRBase mature miRNA counts) of serum EV-enriched fraction, Illumina NovaSeq 6000 (S2.5.p2, S2.6.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Within-subject change in serum EV-enriched miRNA abundance at mid-AAE, immediately post-AAE and 75 min post-AAE relative to pre-AAE baseline, in adults with MDD after one 30-min moderate cycling bout (S2.2.p1, S2.7.p1). Single arm, no resting control (S4.5.p4).
final.inclusion: 30 pre, 29 mid, 28 post, 28 75-min samples after 10 library failures; no outliers removed (S2.5.p2, S2.6.p1)
planned_contrasts: mid vs pre (S3.3.p2; paper: 15 DE, 13 down / 2 up)
post vs pre (S3.3.p2; paper: 33 DE, all down)
post75 vs pre (S3.3.p2; paper: 4 DE, all up)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 v1.44 ~ ID + Treatment, Wald tests, BH; size factors from unfiltered matrix; keep miRNAs with >=10 normalized counts in >=3 samples; non-converging genes (2%) excluded (S2.7.p1)
final.paper_results: 15/33/4 DE at FDR<=0.05; 2,609 miRNAs after filtering (S3.2.p4); Table 1

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Methods S2.7.p1 define one DESeq2 model on all samples with subject ID and time as factors and three Wald contrasts vs pre-AAE; FDR<=0.05 with no fold-change rule. FDR<=0.10 is reported only as trending.

checks: matrix median library size 560,077 equals S3.2.p4 median of 560,077 counts per sample
features are miRBase mature hsa- names

ownership.reasoning: Data availability names GSE320360; sample counts per timepoint and median library size match the paper exactly.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (e.g. 352_E1) equal the Library name inside description for 115/115 samples. Suffix E1/E2/E3/E6 crosstabs one-to-one with characteristics treatment Baseline/Mid/Post/75 min. Subject IDs get an 's' prefix so they are a factor, not a numeric covariate.

matrix.reasoning: All integers, max 4.0e6, median 5; GEO data_processing: tab-delimited matrix of raw miRNA read counts; paper fits DESeq2 on raw counts (S2.7.p1).

design.subject: subject

final.estimand_type: within-subject temporal change (no resting control; not attributable to exercise alone, S4.5.p4)

candidates.reason_rejected: paper tests each timepoint against baseline separately (S2.7.p1)
paper fits one ~ ID + Treatment model on all samples

design.reasoning: S2.7.p1: one model on all samples, time as factor with pre as reference plus subject ID; three planned contrasts. Pairwise comparisons among mid/post/post75 come from the same model as exploratory. Sex is not in GEO metadata and miRNA features carry no X/Y genes, so no sex check is possible.

covariance.reasoning: Repeated samples from the same 30 participants; paper blocks on ID as a fixed factor (S2.7.p1). Sequencing pool/lane is not recorded in GEO, so it cannot be assessed.

deviations: low-count filter on raw counts (>=10 in >=3 samples; 2,611 kept) instead of DESeq2-normalized counts (~2,596 kept with our size factors); paper reports 2,609 kept (S3.2.p4)
pydeseq2 instead of R DESeq2; the paper's exclusion of non-converging genes (2%) is not replicated
pydeseq2 Cook's outlier refit may differ from R

method.reasoning: Reproduces the paper's DESeq2 within-subject model. The runner's low-count filter works on raw counts; only 36 miRNAs are zero-free, so size factors come from the same genes either way, and the raw rule keeps a count (2,611) closer to the paper's reported 2,609 than the normalized rule (~2,596).

threshold.reasoning: S2.7.p1/S3.3.p2: adjusted p <= 0.05 significant, no fold-change cutoff; audit = paper's trending FDR <= 0.10.

caveats: single-arm repeated-measures design without a resting control: changes are temporal, not attributable to exercise alone (S4.5.p4)
paper used R DESeq2 and a normalized-count filter; DE counts near the FDR boundary may differ

study.reasoning: Paper Table 1 FDR<=0.05 miRNAs per contrast; hsa-miR-1252-3p added for 75 min (FDR 0.071, trending) because the paper highlights it as persistent (S3.3.p3).

discrepancies.data: raw rule keeps 2,611, normalized rule ~2,596 with our size factors
pydeseq2 does not flag per-gene convergence the same way
not recorded in GEO; not modelled (the paper did not model it either)

executions.name: joint
executions.reasoning: One DESeq2 model ~ subject + time on all 115 samples; the three vs-pre contrasts are the paper's, the others exploratory.
